faq.question: Q1. What is MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MAHE Recruitment 2026 is an invitation for applications for 3 research positions under an ICMR funded project at the Department of Medical Genetics, Kasturba Medical College, Manipal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available, comprising 2 positions for Project Technical Support - III and 1 position for Project Technical Support - II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MAHE research positions?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: Candidates require a 3 years Graduate Degree in a relevant subject/field with 3 years of post-qualification experience, or a PG in a relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support - II?
faq.answer: Candidates require 12th in Science along with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) and 5 years of experience in a relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply with a detailed CV including copies of certificates in support of qualification and past experience to [email protected], mentioning the job code in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on qualifications and past experience, and shortlisted individuals are informed by email about the interview date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support positions?
faq.answer: Project Technical Support - III receives Rs. 28,000 + 10% HRA (Rs. 30,800 per month), and Project Technical Support - II receives Rs. 20,000 + 10% HRA (Rs. 22,000 per month).

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of engagement for these positions?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for a period of one year and is extendable up to four years based on performance and project need.
